description: This file provides low-level I/O routines for hardware interaction on a PowerPC architecture, including inline functions for port input/output operations, byte order conversions, and memory barriers.

methods.name: uint8_t in_8(const volatile uint8_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from a hardware register address.

methods.name: void out_8(volatile uint8_t * addr,uint8_t val)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to a hardware register address.

methods.name: uint16_t in_le16(const volatile uint16_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit little-endian value from a hardware register address.

methods.name: uint16_t in_be16(const volatile uint16_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit big-endian value from a hardware register address.

methods.name: void out_le16(volatile uint16_t * addr,uint16_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit little-endian value to a hardware register address.

methods.name: void out_be16(volatile uint16_t * addr,uint16_t val)
methods.description: Prints a 16-bit big-endian value to a hardware register address.

methods.name: uint32_t in_le32(const volatile uint32_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit little-endian value from a hardware register address.

methods.name: uint32_t in_be32(const volatile uint32_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit big-endian value from a hardware register address.

methods.name: void out_le32(volatile uint32_t * addr,uint32_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit little-endian value to a hardware register address.

methods.name: void out_be32(volatile uint32_t * addr,uint32_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit big-endian value to a hardware register address.

methods.name: void eieio(void)
methods.description: Ensure in-order execution of I/O operations.

methods.name: void barrier(void)
methods.description: Compiler memory barrier to prevent reordering.
